description: Frontend consistency unification (the original user request's §4 / design §10 step 5): audit the per-page inconsistencies in component usage and text (button labels, status labels, etc.) across the GRAN pages and consolidate them into shared components and shared constants, with a SINGLE source of truth for status->display-label mappings. Must comply with the existing semantic-token rules (docs/ui-design-system.md and regulation §4). Because the backend OOP refactor preserved external contracts, the frontend follows without contract changes; this feature changes only presentation-layer duplication, not user-visible wording where that wording is a preserved contract. Depends on FEAT-001..003 being green (works on the refactored tree) but is otherwise independent of backend internals.
steps: Read docs/ui-design-system.md and regulation §4 FIRST to learn the semantic-token rules and existing shared-component conventions. Read src/components/ui/button.tsx, src/components/ui/Toast.tsx, src/components/layout/navConfig.ts and the per-feature components under src/features/*/components to see what is duplicated.

Audit: grep the codebase for duplicated inline button labels, status strings, and status->label mappings (e.g. EntryStatus/WaitlistStatus/CapacityStatus/tier -> Japanese labels, 'OPEN'/'FEW'/'FULL' badges, entry 'CONFIRMED'/'WAITING'/'CANCELLED'/'ATTENDED' labels). Produce a short inventory (in this feature's findings field) of each duplicated label/component and where it appears. Distinguish: (a) strings that are preserved Server Action contract wording (do NOT change these) vs (b) presentation labels safe to consolidate.

Create a single source of truth for status->display-label mappings as shared constants/types (place in src/types or src/components per regulation §1.2 promotion targets; UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants, PascalCase types). Reuse domain literal types (EntryStatus, WaitlistStatus, TournamentTier, CapacityStatus) as the keys so the mapping is exhaustive and type-checked. Do not duplicate the mapping per page.

Consolidate repeated UI into shared components (e.g. a status Badge, a consistent action Button usage) under src/components/ui, following existing button.tsx/Toast.tsx patterns and semantic tokens (no hard-coded colors where a token exists).

Replace per-page inline labels/components with the shared constants/components, page by page, preserving any contract-wording strings verbatim. Keep each page rendering the same user-visible text (consolidation, not rewording) unless the inconsistency itself is the bug being fixed and the design-system defines the canonical label.

Update or add component tests (follow src/features/data/components/__tests__/panels.branches.test.tsx and src/components/layout/__tests__/navConfig.test.ts patterns) to cover the shared label mapping (exhaustive status->label) and shared Badge/Button rendering.
acceptance_criteria: A single shared status->display-label source of truth exists and is used by all pages that previously inlined those labels (no remaining duplicate mapping).
Shared Badge/Button (or equivalent) replace the duplicated per-page variants, consistent with docs/ui-design-system.md semantic tokens.
Preserved Server Action contract wording is unchanged; no DB/backend contract touched.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0; npm test passes (including new/updated component tests); npm run build succeeds (external SQLite-lock caveat per context.json).
verification: npx vitest run src/components src/features  (expect component tests incl. the new label-mapping test pass)
npm test  (expect all pass, Property 7 still passes)
npm run build  (expect success; apply external-lock caveat on SQLite 'database is locked')
findings:
AUDIT (duplicated presentation labels/components found):
- Capacity status (OPEN/FEW/FULL -> 空き枠あり/残りわずか/満員 (キャンセル待ち)): inlined in CapacityMeter.tsx resolveTone() and partially re-stated in ScheduleControls.tsx STATUS_OPTIONS (FEW/WAITLIST labels). Regulation §4.3 provides the CANONICAL CapacityBadge sample with exactly these labels+tokens (authoritative).
- Entry kind (EntrySummary.kind CONFIRMED/WAITING/CANCELLED/ATTENDED): inlined badge markup in EnteredTournamentsModal.tsx EntryRow (bg-emerald/amber/slate pills + 確定/キャンセル済/終了 text).
- Tournament category/tier/status labels ALREADY had a single source (tournaments/types/tournament.ts: CATEGORY_LABEL/TIER_LABEL/STATUS_LABEL) and shared badges (tournaments/components/badges.tsx CategoryBadge/TierBadge) from earlier FEATs — reused, NOT duplicated.
- home mock data (data/homeData.ts statusLabel '要メンバー登録'/'エントリー確定') are FREE-TEXT mock strings, NOT an enum->label mapping, so left as-is (not a mapping duplication).
- PRESERVED CONTRACT WORDING (NOT changed): toActionResult.ts error messages ('この大会は満員です。...' etc.) are Server Action contract strings — untouched.

CHANGES:
- NEW src/components/ui/statusLabels.ts = single source of truth. Record maps keyed by domain literal types (exhaustive/type-checked): CAPACITY_STATUS_LABEL<CapacityStatus>, ENTRY_KIND_LABEL<EntryKind>, ENTRY_STATUS_LABEL<EntryStatus>, WAITLIST_STATUS_LABEL<WaitlistStatus>. Re-exports CATEGORY_LABEL/TIER_LABEL/TOURNAMENT_STATUS_LABEL from tournaments types (no re-definition). EntryKind type exported here.
- NEW src/components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx = shared badge. Generic StatusBadge(tone) with semantic-token tone map (success/warning/danger/info/neutral/brand/accent per §4.2), plus CapacityBadge(status) and EntryKindBadge(kind, children?) wrappers that resolve label+tone from the SoT.
- CapacityMeter.tsx resolveTone now uses CAPACITY_STATUS_LABEL (same 3 visible labels).
- ScheduleControls.tsx STATUS_OPTIONS FEW/WAITLIST labels now reference CAPACITY_STATUS_LABEL (same visible text).
- EnteredTournamentsModal.tsx EntryRow badges now use EntryKindBadge/StatusBadge (same visible text; CANCELLED/終了 pill normalized from bg-slate-200 to the shared neutral token bg-slate-100+border — intentional consolidation).
- NEW test src/components/ui/__tests__/statusBadge.test.tsx (node env, renderToStaticMarkup) covers exhaustive label maps + CapacityBadge/EntryKindBadge/StatusBadge rendering. 10 tests pass.

NOTE for later FEATs/final-doc step: statusLabels.ts is the intended import point for any future status->label needs (do not re-inline). regulation §4.3's inline CapacityBadge sample now has a real shared implementation at src/components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx (CapacityBadge) — the final-doc step may reference it.

VERIFICATION (this commit): npx tsc --noEmit = exit 0. npm test = 97 passed / 1 failed where the only failure is dataRepository.ranking.test.ts Property 6 TIMING OUT at 5000ms under full-suite load (flaky fast-check SQLite test, unrelated to this frontend-only change; PASSES in isolation at 4845ms — re-ran green). Property 7 passed. My new statusBadge.test.tsx (10) passed. npm run build FAILED ONLY with external SQLite 'database is locked' (errcode 261) at src/lib/db.ts:44 during /data page-data collection (user's running node/dev processes hold the WAL lock) — compiled + TypeScript steps succeeded; this is the documented environment lock, not a code regression. Did not kill user processes.
